## PRB1.7. Investments {#prb1.7.-investments .Heading-2-ER}

- Avinor ANS planned a total asset value for new investments in RP4 of 193.3M€2022, of which 59.7% relates to new major investments. Avinor ANS planned 4 new major investments for RP4, of which 1 has started and 3 have not yet started. Avinor ANS reported 1 additional major investment not foreseen as part of the performance plan which has not yet started.

- In 2025, Avinor ANS underspent -0.2M€2022 (-52.0%) in costs related to new major investments. This is mainly attributable to the ATCC Bodo.

- According to the reporting tables, Avinor ANS overspent +0.4M€2022 (+1.0%) in costs related to investments in 2025.

- Avinor ANS reported no funding from Union assistance programmes in 2025.
